brief:
Gadi Eisenkot, tasked with forming Israel's next government, accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of deliberately prolonging coalition negotiations as a deadline approaches, Middle East Eye reported Friday. Eisenkot did not specify what consequences the missed deadline might trigger or detail the terms under which the government formation process is being conducted.

The accusation reflects mounting tension in Israel's political negotiations over cabinet formation, with Eisenkot's criticism suggesting disputes over the pace and substance of talks between political blocs.

title: Israeli opposition leader accuses Netanyahu of stalling coalition talks
